description: This file implements the 'Underflow' class, which handles buffer underflow events in a media streaming context. It manages state related to underflow detection, notifies clients of buffer underflow or end-of-stream conditions, and checks if all media sources have reached end-of-stream.

classes.description: A class that manages buffer underflow events, including notifying clients and checking for end-of-stream conditions.

methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the Underflow object lifecycle.
